from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.STAR_SOLVE_24_DIRECT,
                prompt_custom.STAR_SOLVE_24_GROUPING,
                prompt_custom.STAR_SOLVE_24_BACKTRACK,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.STAR_AGG_24,
        )
        draft = await star(problem)
        coord = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SWC_WORKER_24] * 3,
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.SWC_COORDINATOR_24,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        solution = await coord(f"Problem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft candidate:\n{draft.get('response') or 'cannot form 24'}")
        return solution.get("response") or "```\ncannot form 24\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }
